A.title: NEBULA KINGDOM
A.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Edit this GEOMETRY REFERENCE into ONE complete final concept map preview: OPTION A NEBULA KINGDOM. This is a design mockup, not a tileset, not a perspective painting. Preserve original canvas aspect ratio 1038:800, landscape, STRICT TOP-DOWN 2D orthographic Tower Defense map. The reference pale path must remain exactly the same geometry: FIVE long horizontal lanes, connected alternately at right, left, right, left, ONE unbranched continuous snake route. Preserve path centerline, thickness ~44/1038 canvas width, five lane positions, square corners, upper-left spawn and bottom-right base. DO NOT add a sixth lane, gaps, branches, central shortcuts, circular roads or road crossings. Replace reference flat colors with polished cartoon game art. Theme: Muted purple and midnight-blue cosmic ground, gently textured with subtle nebula swirls. Road built of pale lavender astral stone slabs, bright clear bevel edges and restrained violet light in joints. Sparse faceted nebula crystals in purple/blue, small meteors and tiny stars clustered near outer margins. Spawn is a teal-violet arcane arrival platform at upper-left endpoint. Base is a small warm-gold fantasy citadel on a violet star platform at bottom-right endpoint. Fantasy cartoon galaxy, richly illustrated but gameplay ground remains calm. Tower placement ground is clearly differentiated from road, muted, low contrast, with broad empty regions suitable for building. Road has clear solid borders, safe open interior and modest modular tile rhythm. Keep decor small, sparse, away from road and endpoints. Maintain at least 5% border clearance. No HUD, sidebar, shop, UI panels, towers, monsters or text except small readable labels 'SPAWN' and 'BASE' beside their platforms. No map title or option lettering in the art. Right map boundary must end within this canvas; no design extends into a sidebar. Ground should plausibly come from seamless repeatable tiles, road from horizontal/vertical/corner modules, never baked gameplay. Crisp clean fantasy/cartoon illustration with bold readable forms and warm accents compatible with existing wooden Archer Towers. Not photorealistic, not 3D/isometric.
